notes: 10-07 C5 decision (statement first, before any proof): option A, the checkpoint carries the base machine's owed work. Option B (rotation waits for the queue to drain) is refused: an owed receipt to a disconnected peer may never drain, so B leaves the generation to grow to its 8192-record bound with no rotation, a liveness hole the spec would have to state as one. scenario: A node that ever queued a receipt or report job and still owes it cannot rotate: natural rotation (fn-bpnrd-due-rotation-event) answers NIL on quiescence, so the generation fills toward its 8192-record bound while jobs are owed. The documented stage-cut recovery claim (owed receipt jobs survive a death before selection) cannot be exercised.
title: bp-node checkpoint and natural rotation refuse whenever the base machine has any job, so owed receipt jobs make the journal unrotatable and the stage-cut recovery case unreachable
